decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-quality Bluetooth speaker with strong bass and clear sound. I filtered out several products that were actually accessories (cases, batteries, adapters). In my consideration set, I included a mix of budget (MusiBaby), performance-oriented (BOGASING), and premium options (Harman Kardon, Sony, JBL). The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) is the final choice because of its excellent 4.7 rating and positive feedback regarding its sound depth and 'thump.' While the JBL Pulse 4 has a cool light show, it is significantly more expensive at $249, making the Onyx Studio 6 a better value for a premium audio experience.
